name: Pembrolizumab (adjuvant, resected clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Adjuvant pembrolizumab for approximately 1 year: 200 mg IV every 3 weeks for up to 17 cycles (an every-6-week 400 mg schedule is an accepted label alternative). Stop earlier for recurrence or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event counseling; instruct prompt reporting of new symptoms (diarrhea, dyspnea, rash, fatigue).
Baseline and periodic thyroid, hepatic, adrenal, and glucose assessment.
monitoring: thyroid function (TSH/free T4) before cycles and as indicated
symptom review for colitis, pneumonitis, dermatitis, endocrinopathy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; permanently discontinue for severe or recurrent grade 3-4 events. Obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV flat dose on day 1 of a 21-day cycle for up to 17 cycles (~1 year) as adjuvant therapy for resected higher-risk clear-cell RCC. An every-6-week 400 mg schedule is an accepted label-equivalent alternative. Authored from standard adjuvant RCC practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; KEYNOTE-564 as the supporting evidence layer).

provenance.locator: adjuvant pembrolizumab, resected higher-risk clear-cell RCC
